ἤπιος, -α, -ον 
mild, gentle: 1Th.2.7 (WH, R, mg., νήπιος); before πρός, 2Ti.2.24.†
(AS)

Ἤρ (L, Ἥρ), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. עֵר), 
Er, an ancestor of Jesus: Luk.3.28.†
(AS)

ἤρεμος-ον 
[in LXX Est.3.13 A* ;] 
quiet, tranquil (Luc., al.): 1Ti.2.2.†
